home.about_description: ChordProject is a platform to write, organize, and play songs with chords in ChordPro format. It keeps your library, collections, and repertoires ready on any device.
features: Create and edit songs with aligned chords on any screen or font size.
Organize your library with songbooks, tags, and fast search.
Prepare repertoires by event, with defined spaces, references, and multiple songs when needed.
Use live mode with clear navigation, transposition, fullscreen, and quick font-size controls.
Keep your music synced and ready to open from desktop, tablet, or mobile.
home.platform_description: You can also use HomenaJesus.com, an experience prepared for community songbooks and repertoires.
home.contribute_title: Have an idea to improve it?
home.contribute_description: You can share ideas through the feedback form. If you want to contribute code, this site is also an open source project on GitHub.
